title: SkillBind Bridge Server
description: Server-side bridge for casting MMOCore skill slots from SkillBind Bridge client keybinds.
body:
# SkillBind Bridge Server

SkillBind Bridge Server is the Paper plugin part of the SkillBind Bridge system. It receives keybind input from the SkillBind Bridge Fabric client mod and casts MMOCore skill slots on the server.

This plugin is made for Minecraft servers that use MMOCore and want players to cast skills with custom keybinds instead of relying on the default MMOCore controls.

## Features

* Receives skill keybind input from the Fabric client mod
* Casts MMOCore skill slots from the server side
* Supports configurable maximum skill slot count
* Supports `specific` and `first` MMOCore cast modes
* Includes packet cooldown protection
* Includes permission support with `skillbindbridge.use`
* Lightweight Paper plugin

## Requirements

### Server

* Paper
* Java 21
* MMOCore
* SkillBind Bridge Server plugin

### Client

Players must install the SkillBind Bridge Fabric client mod to send keybind input to the server.

## Important

This plugin does not add skills by itself. It only acts as a bridge between the client keybind mod and MMOCore skill casting.

The Fabric client mod and this Paper plugin must be installed together for the system to work.

For MMOCore servers, it is recommended to disable the default MMOCore skill casting mode if you want to prevent accidental skill usage from number keys or mouse wheel scrolling.
